CHN.scope: China consolidated central and local budget (excludes extra-budgetary funds), 1990 actual, NBS Statistical Yearbook; 4.783 yuan per US$. Rates approximate.

mechs.name: State enterprise income tax
mechs.note: Income tax on state-owned enterprises, 1990 actual. Large and medium SOEs paid a flat 55% on profit (small ones a progressive scale); the remaining profit after tax was shared with enterprises through contract-responsibility deals, so the effective yield is lower.

mechs.name: Collective enterprise income tax
mechs.note: Income tax on collectively owned (mostly township and urban collective) enterprises, 1990 actual, on an eight-grade progressive scale up to 55%. Rate shown is an approximate average.

mechs.name: Product tax
mechs.note: Product tax (chanpin shui) levied on 26 categories of industrial output, mainly tobacco, liquor, petroleum, chemicals, machinery and textiles, at rates from a few percent up to 60% on cigarettes. Rate shown is an approximate average.

mechs.name: Value-added tax
mechs.note: 1984-style VAT on 12 product categories (machinery, steel, cars, textiles, etc.) at 6% to 16%, with no credit for capital goods; the general 17% rate only began in 1994. Rate shown is approximate.

mechs.name: Business tax
mechs.note: Turnover tax (yingye shui) on services, transport, construction, finance, trade and communications at about 3% to 15% of revenue; 3% for most transport and construction, 5% for finance.

mechs.name: Other industrial and commercial taxes
mechs.note: Remainder of the 'industrial and commercial taxes' group after product tax, VAT and business tax: salt tax, urban maintenance and construction tax, resource tax, special fuel tax, taxes on foreign-invested enterprises and individuals, and other minor items. The yearbook does not split this out.

mechs.name: Tariffs
mechs.note: Customs duties on imports, 1990 actual, collected by the General Administration of Customs. Duty rates were high with extensive exemptions; revenue is about 7% of imports.

mechs.name: Agricultural taxes
mechs.note: Agricultural tax (grain in kind, converted), animal husbandry and agricultural specialty taxes, slaughter tax and farmland occupation tax, 1990 actual. The yearbook groups them as agricultural and related taxes.

mechs.name: Profit remittances from enterprises
mechs.note: Profits and dividends handed over by state-owned enterprises under the contract system, beyond income tax.

mechs.name: Subsidies to loss-making enterprises
mechs.note: Budget subsidies covering losses of state enterprises (mostly grain, cotton, oil trade and coal), recorded in China's accounts as a deduction from revenue. Negative offset.

mechs.name: Energy and transport key construction fund
mechs.note: Levy on enterprise and extra-budgetary funds earmarked for key energy and transport construction projects, raised from 1983.

mechs.name: Budget adjustment fund
mechs.note: Fund collected from enterprises and localities to adjust the budget, introduced 1989 as a surcharge to finance central priorities.

mechs.name: Other revenue
mechs.note: Remaining government income, including fees, fines, asset sales and administrative receipts.
